verse: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
verse_spoken: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
prayer: Lord Jesus, I come to you this morning tired and carrying more than I was made to carry.
You invited the weary to come to you, so I am coming just as I am.
Take the weight of the worries I have held on to for far too long.
Quiet my racing thoughts and slow my anxious heart in your presence.
Teach me to stop striving to earn what you have already freely given.
Give me deep and peaceful sleep, and wake me with new strength.
Help me rest in your love even on the busiest of days.
Refresh everyone praying with me who feels worn out and heavy laden right now.
Thank you that in you my soul can finally be still.
